name: Car Video
subtitle: Videos and YouTube on CarPlay
description: Watch your own videos and YouTube on the CarPlay screen. Add videos from Files, Photos or a link, browse them in a grid sized for your car's screen, and control playback by touch, steering-wheel buttons or the iPhone. YouTube runs full screen on the car with an on-screen keyboard. Video is hidden while the car is moving (can be turned off). Needs TrollStore: the car screen uses a private entitlement.

versions.localizedDescription:
Car YouTube keeps a readable page width on wide screens; centre the grid

- The car page is kept to about 1100 px wide (zooming in further on very
  wide screens), where YouTube's layout and text still work.
- The video grid is centred vertically when the screen has spare height.
- Screenshots from the CarPlay simulator test for the TrollApps source.
